about_the_game:
Demo includes one playable character and one stage.
Master the Power of Synergy in Multi Deck Hero!

Multi Deck Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder where strategy and synergy determine your survival. With three dynamic decks at your command, you must tactically combine your cards, unlock powerful charms, and defeat an endless wave of evolving enemies.

Every turn, make the most of your cards, create devastating combos, and discover new strategies with each run. Will you master the perfect deck or fall to the growing challenge?

🃏 Key Features:

  • Unique Multi-Deck System – Draw and play from three different decks, mixing strategies to outsmart your foes.

  • Powerful Charms – Unlock game-changing passive effects that enhance your deck’s synergy.

  • Roguelike Progression – Face increasingly powerful enemies and adapt to ever-changing challenges.

  • Endless Replayability – No two runs are the same, thanks to randomized card offerings and charm combinations.

Can You Build the Ultimate Deck?

Survive, strategize, and prove your skills in Multi Deck Hero! Wishlist now and prepare for the challenge!

👉 Wishlist Now! 🚀
